notes: YouTube videos work in the video card after all. The obstacle was that panels are local pages with no web address, and YouTube will not send a video to a page it cannot identify. The app now serves one tiny page from your own machine for…

That small local page is only running while a YouTube video is actually set, answers exactly one request, requires a key generated fresh each time the app starts, and is reachable only from this computer.
The message shown when a video will not play no longer runs into the edges of its frame.
